input/give:
execute unless entity @s[tag=ll.player,tag=ct.player] run return 0
execute unless score @s ll_table = @s ct_id run return 0
scoreboard players operation #give_table ll_ctx = @s ll_table
scoreboard players operation #give_seat ll_ctx = @s ll_seat
tag @e[tag=ll.inventory_me] remove ll.inventory_me
tag @e[tag=ll.inventory_controller] remove ll.inventory_controller
execute as @e[tag=ll.part] if score @s ct_id = #give_table ll_ctx if score @s ll_seat = #give_seat ll_ctx run tag @s add ll.inventory_me
execute as @e[tag=ll.controller,scores={ct_state=1}] if score @s ct_id = #give_table ll_ctx run tag @s add ll.inventory_controller
execute unless entity @e[tag=ll.inventory_me,limit=1] run return 0
execute unless entity @e[tag=ll.inventory_controller,limit=1] run return 0
execute store result storage love_letter:input table int 1 run scoreboard players get @s ll_table
execute store result storage love_letter:input epoch int 1 run scoreboard players get @e[tag=ll.inventory_controller,limit=1] ll_epoch
execute store result storage love_letter:input owner int 1 run scoreboard players get @s ll_seat
function love_letter:input/give_tools with storage love_letter:input
input/give_tools:
$function love_letter:input/place_tool {table:$(table),slot:8,action:0,name:"情书 · 操作与选择（Q）",model:"minecraft:purple_dye"}
execute unless entity @e[tag=ll.inventory_me,scores={ll_alive=1},limit=1] run return run clear @s *[minecraft:custom_data~{love_letter:{hand:1b}}]
scoreboard players operation #hand_card ll_ctx = @e[tag=ll.inventory_me,limit=1] ll_hand
data modify storage love_letter:input slot set value 0

input/check_drop:
# table-pause: begin (tools/build_table_pause_guards.py)
execute if score @s ct_paused matches 1 run return 0
execute if entity @s[type=minecraft:item,tag=ct.paused_return] run return 0
execute on origin if score @s ct_paused matches 1 run return 0
# table-pause: end
scoreboard players set #drop_owner ll_ctx 0
execute on origin if entity @s[tag=ll.dropper,tag=ll.player] run scoreboard players set #drop_owner ll_ctx 1
execute unless score #drop_owner ll_ctx matches 1 run return 0
data modify storage love_letter:input dropped set from entity @s Item.components."minecraft:custom_data".love_letter
execute if data storage love_letter:input dropped{hand:1b} as @a[tag=ll.dropper,limit=1] run function love_letter:direct/play with storage love_letter:input dropped
execute if data storage love_letter:input dropped{hand:1b} run return run kill @s
execute store result score #tool_action ll_ctx run data get entity @s Item.components."minecraft:custom_data".love_letter.action
kill @s
execute as @a[tag=ll.dropper,limit=1] run function love_letter:input/give
execute if score #tool_action ll_ctx matches 8 as @a[tag=ll.dropper,limit=1] at @s run return run function love_letter:ui/menu
execute as @a[tag=ll.dropper,limit=1] at @s run function love_letter:ui/open
ui/refresh:
# table-pause: begin (tools/build_table_pause_guards.py)
execute if score @s ct_paused matches 1 run return 0
execute if entity @s[type=minecraft:item,tag=ct.paused_return] run return 0
execute on origin if score @s ct_paused matches 1 run return 0
# table-pause: end
# 只对当前决策玩家展开选择；旁观者与其他玩家不会被强制弹窗。
function love_letter:system/context
scoreboard players set @a[tag=ll.audience] ll_pick -1
scoreboard players set @a[tag=ll.audience] ll_action 0
scoreboard players enable @a[tag=ll.audience] ll_action
execute as @a[tag=ll.audience] run function love_letter:input/give
execute unless score @s ll_state matches 2 run return 0
execute unless score @s ll_anim matches 0 run return 0
scoreboard players operation #ui_decider ll_ctx = @s ll_actor
execute if score @s ll_phase matches 1 run scoreboard players operation #ui_decider ll_ctx = @s ll_turn
execute unless score @s ll_phase matches 1 as @a[tag=ll.audience] if score @s ll_seat = #ui_decider ll_ctx run function love_letter:ui/open

execute if score @s ct_paused matches 1 run return 0
execute if entity @s[type=minecraft:item,tag=ct.paused_return] run return 0

scoreboard players set @s ll_tick 0
function love_letter:system/context

execute as @a[tag=ll.audience] run scoreboard players add #online ll_ctx 1
function love_letter:hud/refresh

execute as @a[tag=ll.audience] run function love_letter:input/give
game/start:
scoreboard players set @s ct_start 0
execute unless score @s ct_joined matches 2..6 run return run function love_letter:game/bad_count
execute if score @s ct_capacity matches 4 unless score @s ct_joined matches 2..4 run return run function love_letter:game/bad_count
execute unless score @s ct_capacity matches 4 unless score @s ct_capacity matches 8 run return fail
scoreboard players operation #table ll_ctx = @s ct_id
scoreboard players set #occupied ll_ctx 0
execute as @a[tag=ct.player] if score @s ct_id = #table ll_ctx if items entity @s hotbar.0 * run scoreboard players set #occupied ll_ctx 1
execute as @a[tag=ct.player] if score @s ct_id = #table ll_ctx if items entity @s hotbar.8 * run scoreboard players set #occupied ll_ctx 1
execute as @a[tag=ct.player] if score @s ct_id = #table ll_ctx if items entity @s hotbar.1 * run scoreboard players set #occupied ll_ctx 1
execute if score #occupied ll_ctx matches 1 run return run function love_letter:game/bad_slots
function love_letter:game/clear

function love_letter:system/context
scoreboard players set @s ll_players 0
execute as @e[tag=ll.board] run scoreboard players add @e[tag=ll.current,limit=1] ll_players 1
execute unless score @s ll_players matches 2..6 run return run function love_letter:game/start_failed
scoreboard players set @s ll_goal 3
execute if score @s ll_players matches 2 run scoreboard players set @s ll_goal 6
execute if score @s ll_players matches 3 run scoreboard players set @s ll_goal 5
execute if score @s ll_players matches 4 run scoreboard players set @s ll_goal 4
execute if score @s ll_goal_setting matches 1..10 run scoreboard players operation @s ll_goal = @s ll_goal_setting
scoreboard players set @s ll_round 0
scoreboard players set @s ll_tick 0
scoreboard players set @s ll_first 99
execute as @e[tag=ll.board] run scoreboard players operation @e[tag=ll.current,limit=1] ll_first < @s ll_seat
execute if score @s ll_first_setting matches 0 run scoreboard players operation @s ll_first = @e[tag=ll.board,sort=random,limit=1] ll_seat
scoreboard players set @s ct_start 1
